charts.name: Código de Contas do SNCRF (Portaria n.º 49/2008) — selecção para sociedades comerciais
charts.legal_reference: Decreto-Lei n.º 5/2008 approves the Sistema de Normalização Contabilística e de Relato Financeiro and Portaria n.º 49/2008 publishes its Código de Contas, classes 1 to 7 (class 5 holds equity and the result, classes 6 and 7 the expenses and the income; there is no class 8). The chart carries the official codes and names, with the levels of detail a trading company posts to; it is a selection, not the whole code, and the official code leaves free levels where it prints «…». Where this pack adds a level the code leaves free, it says so: 68881 Arredondamentos (rounding) under 6888. The codes 24421 to 24423 (deductible VAT), 24431 to 24433 (VAT charged) and 24461 (VAT payable, amounts assessed) are the code's own sub-accounts of 244.

numbering.legal_reference: Código do IVA, article 25(1)(b): an invoice is issued for every supply of goods or services, even when the buyer does not ask for it. The numbering rules of the invoice (articles 32 and following, and the Portaria on invoicing) were not read; the sequential number per year is the pack's example, not the official series, and the e-Fatura platform assigns its own authorised numbers (README).

tax_point.legal_reference: Código do IVA, article 7(1): the tax is due and chargeable when the goods are placed at the buyer's disposal and, for services, when they are performed; for continuous supplies with successive payments, at the end of the period each payment covers (article 7(3)). Article 8 adds the invoice rule (the tax is chargeable when the invoice is issued if it is issued before) that the pack does not model. `delivery_date` is the closest value of Ekwo's vocabulary.

posted_edit_policy.legal_reference: Código do IVA, article 25(6): an invoice is issued again when the taxable amount or the tax changes for any reason, including inaccuracy. A posted entry is therefore corrected with a credit note and a new invoice, not erased.

mentions.legal_reference: Código do IVA, article 9 (exempt operations) and article 13 (exports): the invoice states the reason the tax is not applied (article 32(5)(e), as printed in the 2015 republication). The exact wording to print is the pack's, not the law's.

einvoicing.legal_reference: Cabo Verde has no Peppol authority, no EN 16931 profile and no ISO 6523 scheme a party is addressed by, so `profile`, `party_scheme` and `vat_scheme` are null and `obligation` is `none`. What the country has is a clearance-style platform run by the tax administration: the e-Fatura issues electronic invoices and other tax-relevant documents (DFE) as XML with a digital signature and an authorisation of use granted by the tax administration in real time, and says taxpayers previously accredited by it must issue them. The accreditation schedule by taxpayer was not found on the pages read. Ekwo does not connect to the platform; the gap is in the README and in docs/international.md.
